title: 26-Layer Chirped Stack with Explicit Thickness Clamping
scientific_hypothesis: A 26-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 chirped stack with thicknesses clamped to [20nm, 250nm] and reduced chirp frequency will produce physically valid candidates while maintaining dual-band spectral performance, addressing the material_data failure from iteration_13.
design_principle: Quadratic chirp with explicit bounds prevents numerical overflow in TMM while preserving broadband UV reflection through controlled phase accumulation across the stack.
proposed_topology: 26 layers total, alternating HfO2/SiO2 starting with HfO2 at air interface, ending with SiO2 at substrate. Exact sequence: H-L-H-L-H-L-H-L-H-L-H-L-H-L-H-L-H-L-H-L-H-L-H-L-H-L (13 pairs).
design_variables: 26 layer thicknesses with quadratic chirp initialization, clamped to [20nm, 250nm]
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: All thicknesses within [20nm, 250nm] feasible for e-beam or ion-assisted deposition
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for planar multilayer interference
Chirped DBR principle for broadband reflection
expected_advantages: Explicit thickness bounds prevent material_data failures
Reduced chirp rate prevents rapid phase drift
26 layers provides sufficient degrees of freedom for dual-band optimization
known_risks: Thickness clamping may limit optimization freedom
Chirped designs sensitive to deposition errors
May not achieve iteration_02 best score of 0.7972
execution_request_english: Design a 26-layer planar dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: alternating HfO2 (high index) and SiO2 (low index), starting with HfO2 at air interface, ending with SiO2 at substrate (13 H-L pairs total). Initialize thicknesses using quadratic chirp profile with base period centered at 375 nm for UV reflection band, then apply gradient-based thickness optimization. Enforce hard bounds: all layer thicknesses must be clamped to [20 nm, 250 nm] immediately after initialization and maintained throughout optimization. Evaluate at normal incidence, unpolarized light. Spectral bands: maximize reflectance in 300-450 nm, maximize transmittance in 1000-1700 nm. Use coherent TMM. Report thicknesses_nm, best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, run_status. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1000-1700 nm; transmission in 300-450 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum total layer count of 30.
revision_reason: Iteration_13 produced 0 valid candidates due to material_data failure. This route adds explicit [20nm, 250nm] thickness clamping per feedback directives, reduces chirp frequency modulation rate by half, and adds finite-value guard checks to prevent silent abort.
